mechanism: Nortriptyline (tricyclic antidepressant) can antagonize the antihypertensive effects of guanfacine through alpha-2 adrenergic receptor interference, while both drugs increase CNS depression risk and guanfacine may inhibit metabolism of nortriptyline via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; guanfacine dose may need adjustment; educate patient on orthostatic hypotension risk and CNS depression effects; consider alternative antidepressant if blood pressure control becomes problematic.
